column1: 22307§mixture§ˈmɪkstʃə(r)§Today, scientists continue to experiment with new glass mixtures.§如今，科学家们继续对新型的玻璃**混合物**进行试验。§

22308§tendency§ˈtendənsi§The effort to clean up cars may do little to cut pollution if nothing is done about the tendency to drive them more.§驾驶汽车的人越来越多，如果不采取措施遏制这一**趋势**，那么即使下力气对汽车进行清理整顿，这对减少污染也不会起到什么作用。§
22309§lane§leɪn§Vehicles carrying more than one person can use special priority lanes, which means they can travel more quickly.§载有一位以上乘客的车辆可以使用特殊的优先级**车道**，这就意味着它们能行驶得更快。§
22310§assess§əˈses§Core samples are always extracted to assess the quality and quantity of coal at a site before mining.§在开采前，通常会收集选地的矿样来**评估**矿质和储量。§
22311§inductive§ɪnˈdʌktɪv§The myth of scientific method is that it is inductive.§科学方法的神秘之处就在于它的**归纳**性。§
22312§session§ˈseʃn§This course is made up of 15 sessions.§这门课共上15**节**。§
22313§constrain§kənˈstreɪn§The evidence was so compelling that he felt constrained to accept it.§证据是那样的令人折服，他觉得**不得不**接受。§
22314§negative§ˈneɡətɪv§This policy had a negative effect on their business.§这一政策给他们的生意带来了**消极**影响。§
22315§unwrap§ʌnˈræp§I sat on the chair to unwrap the package while he stood behind me.§我坐在椅子上**打开**包裹，当时他就站在我身后。§
22316§punctual§ˈpʌŋktʃuəl§Being punctual shows your clients that you respect their schedule and that you can be counted on.§**守时**会让你的客户觉得，你尊重他们的安排，并且值得信赖。§
22317§intake§ˈɪnteɪk§It is important not to decrease salt intake too much, as sodium is an essential mineral for the body to function.§钠是维持机体运转的重要矿物元素，因此避免过度减少食盐的**摄取量**非常重要。§
22318§penetration§ˌpenəˈtreɪʃn§The company's successful penetration into the e-business environment survived the depression.§这个公司成功地**进军**电子商务领域，终于挺过了大萧条时期。§改例句：可数名词单数 environment 前缺冠词，补 the
22319§plagiarise§ˈpleɪdʒəraɪz§If you compare the two essays side by side, it is obvious that the author of the first has plagiarised.§如果你对比这两篇文章，就会发现很明显第一篇文章的作者**抄袭**了第二篇。§

22320§municipal§mjuːˈnɪsɪpl§When those were finished, she concluded the session with a brief restatement of how the new system will improve security and peace of mind in the municipal building.§当那些（工作）完成后，她在会议结束时简短地重申了新系统将如何改善**市政**大楼的安全与安宁。§

22321§deficit§ˈdefɪsɪt§The weak dollar plays a significant role in helping the U.S. government to reduce the trade deficit.§疲软的美元在帮助美国政府降低贸易**赤字**上起着重要作用。§改例句：辅音音素开头的 significant 前应为 a，an 错；U.S. government 和 trade deficit 前缺冠词，补 the

22322§triumphant§traɪˈʌmfənt§The newborn infant is triumphant and joyful at each development taken by each consciousness, and he revels and marks great joy in the slightest creative act of each of his issues.§新生婴儿对自己有意识地取得的每一个进展感到**得意**和高兴，并为他所做出的每一个最轻微的创造性行为而陶醉、喜悦。§

22323§reptile§ˈreptaɪl§There were images of the ancient Maya gods in the form of feathered serpents, crouching reptiles and dozens of human figures.§那里满是古代玛雅人的神明的图像：形似长着羽毛的大毒蛇、缩着的**爬虫**和大量的人形。§改例句：作定语应为 Maya，Mayas 错
22324§circumscribe§ˈsɜːkəmskraɪb§The power of the monarchy was severely circumscribed by the newly promulgated laws.§新颁布的法律严格**限制**了君主的权力。§
22325§patronage§ˈpætrənɪdʒ§"That gave those party bosses handy powers of patronage, but it was deadly for democracy," he said angrily.§他愤怒地指出：“那等于给了党派领袖们便利的**任免**大权，却给民主判了死刑。”§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
22326§analogy§əˈnælədʒi§Most of the time, it is easier for us to illustrate an abstract concept by analogy with something concrete.§大多数情况下，我们更易于通过与具体有形的东西进行**类比**来理解某个抽象的概念。§

22327§precedent§ˈpresɪdənt§The October Revolution was without precedent in recent history, which had a significant influence in Russia.§十月革命在近代历史上是没有**先例**的，对俄国产生了深远的影响。§改例句：influence 的搭配是 have an influence，made 用词错
22328§obscurity§əbˈskjʊərəti§This opening chapter tells us how to avoid ambiguity and obscurity of expression.§开篇第一章告诉我们如何避免模糊和**晦涩**的语言表达。§
22329§ascertain§ˌæsəˈteɪn§It must be ascertained whether he is the property owner before you make a down payment.§在交首付之前，你必须**查明**他是否为该房产的业主。§
22330§esteem§ɪˈstiːm§We had great esteem for this dedicated and imaginative scientist.§对这位乐于奉献、富于想象力的科学家，我们深表**敬佩**。§

22331§legitimacy§lɪˈdʒɪtɪməsi§The young man was accused because the victim's families were in serious doubt about the legitimacy of his so-called self-defence action.§这个年轻人遭到指控，因为受害人家属严重质疑他所谓的正当防卫的**合法性**。§
22332§discrepancy§dɪˈskrepənsi§We noticed the obvious discrepancy between these two agreements signed by the two parties.§我们注意到双方签订的这两份合同有着明显的**不同**之处。§

22333§benevolent§bəˈnevələnt§You never know which person is going to show up—the nice, benevolent manager or the insane, angry hophead.§你永远不知道他将以哪种形象出现，是和善**仁慈**的经理还是暴怒的瘾君子。§改译文：原译「一团和气」只译了 nice，没有和 benevolent（仁慈的）对应的词，改为「和善仁慈」
22334§malevolent§məˈlevələnt§Stricken by a series of failures, he was malevolent toward those who were successful.§经过一连串失败的打击，他对那些成功人士充满了**敌意**。§
22335§downsize§ˈdaʊnsaɪz§Some firms are even downsizing as their profits climb.§一些公司甚至在利润增长的同时也在**裁员**。§
22336§lunar§ˈluːnə(r)§The Human Genome Project will take longer to accomplish than the lunar missions.§完成人类基因组工程的耗时将比人类成功登**月**花费的时间还要长。§
22337§complicated§ˈkɒmplɪkeɪtɪd§The other hat we made was more complicated.§我们制作的另外一顶帽子更加**复杂**。§
22338§handle§ˈhændl§Friction management means handling conflicts in a positive and constructive manner.§摩擦管理是指以积极的、建设性的态度来**处理**各种冲突。§
22339§innovation§ˌɪnəˈveɪʃn§The innovation of match-making technology made the waterproof match possible.§火柴制造技术的**革新**使人们生产出防水火柴。§改例句：waterproof 是形容词，后面缺名词，补 match
22340§glitter§ˈglɪtə(r)§Smoothed flat by generations of wind and rain, they glitter in the sun.§它们被一代代的风雨磨平，在阳光下**闪闪发光**。§
22341§council§ˈkaʊnsl§The Council may convoke a formal conference.§**理事会**可能会召开一次正式会议。§

22342§feedback§ˈfiːdbæk§Employee feedback is reviewed daily and some suggestions will be implemented within 48 hours.§员工**反馈**信息每天都会被查看，一些建议会在48小时之内被采纳实施。§改例句：some 修饰可数名词应用复数，suggestion 改为 suggestions
22343§subsequent§ˈsʌbsɪkwənt§This incident was of great importance in the subsequent development of events.§这一事件对**后续**事态的发展影响重大。§
22344§shark§ʃɑːk§Although many people fear them, sharks rarely attack humans and play an important role in keeping ocean ecosystems healthy.§尽管很多人害怕**鲨鱼**，但它们很少攻击人类，而且在维持海洋生态系统健康方面起着重要作用。§补例句
22345§venomous§ˈvenəməs§There are some venomous snakes to beware of in the forest.§森林中有一些需要提防的**毒**蛇。§
22346§intellectual§ˌɪntəˈlektʃuəl§The development of literacy has far-reaching effects on general intellectual development.§文化素质的提高对于人类整体**智力**的发展有着深远的影响。§
22347§strain§streɪn§Tom strained his muscle in the match.§汤姆在比赛中**拉伤**了肌肉。§
22348§terminology§ˌtɜːmɪˈnɒlədʒi§The terminology of meteorology rises every time the temperature falls.§每当降温时，气象学**术语**的热度都随之升高。§
22349§centennial§senˈteniəl§Many statesmen attended the centennial celebration of the founding of the republic.§许多政治家出席了该共和国成立**百年**的纪念庆典。§
22350§Mediterranean§ˌmedɪtəˈreɪniən§We enjoyed such a Mediterranean climate very much.§这种**地中海**式气候让我们很享受。§改例句：可数名词单数 climate 前缺冠词，补 a
22351§outdo§ˌaʊtˈduː§The two universities are always trying to outdo each other academically.§这两所大学总是试图在学术上**超过**对方。§
22352§discipline§ˈdɪsəplɪn§Sports Studies as a discipline is still comparatively new.§体育研究仍是一个相对较新的**学科**。§
22353§consequent§ˈkɒnsɪkwənt§There is always confusion consequent to an earthquake.§地震**过后**总是会发生混乱。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「而）」
22354§fulfil§fʊlˈfɪl§The prophecy was fulfilled.§预言**应验**了。§
22355§element§ˈelɪmənt§Impressed by the element's combustibility, several 17th century chemists used phosphorus to manufacture fire-lighting devices.§磷的燃烧性给17世纪的几位化学家留下了深刻印象，他们开始用这种**元素**制造点火装置。§

22356§segment§ˈsegmənt§He claimed that the essence of reasoning lay in putting together two "behaviour segments" in some novel way.§他称推理的本质就是将两个“行为**片段**”以新的方式整合在一起。§改例句：lie（在于）的过去式是 lay，lied 错；中文引号改为英文引号
22357§orchestra§ˈɔːkɪstrə§Which orchestra do you think is the finest in our country?§你觉得我国最棒的**管弦乐队**是哪一支？§
22358§muscle§ˈmʌsl§If your bed doesn't give enough support, back muscles and ligaments will work all night trying to correct spinal alignment.§如果你的床不能提供足够的支撑，那么背部**肌肉**和韧带就会整晚工作来校直脊椎骨。§
22359§function§ˈfʌŋkʃn§The dams store water for a variety of functions.§大坝贮存的水**用途**广泛。§
22360§metaphor§ˈmetəfə(r)§In literature, the dove is often a metaphor for peace.§在文学作品中鸽子通常是和平的**隐喻**。§改译文：原译「象征」不是 metaphor（隐喻）的意思，改为「隐喻」
22361§delegate§ˈdelɪgət§Negotiation progressed fairly with confidence felt among delegates.§谈判进行得很顺利，**代表**们也都充满信心。§
22362§fragile§ˈfrædʒaɪl§The fragile boxes arrived intact.§这些**易碎**的箱子被完好无损地运到了目的地。§
22363§radiate§ˈreɪdieɪt§The scientist said that the heat, light, and energy that were radiated from the sun filled the entire solar system.§那个科学家说太阳**发出**的热、光和能量遍布整个太阳系。§
22364§situated§ˈsɪtʃueɪtɪd§The Newton Park site is situated four miles west of Bath.§牛顿公园**位于**巴斯以西四英里的地方。§
22365§invader§ɪnˈveɪdə(r)§Their way of life was destroyed by invaders.§他们的生活方式遭到了**入侵者**的破坏。§

22366§complete§kəmˈpliːt§Some people believe that children's leisure activities must be educational, otherwise they are a complete waste of time.§有些人认为孩子们的休闲活动必须具有教育意义，否则那**完全**就是浪费时间。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「全）」
22367§kit§kɪt§The plumber reached into his tool kit for a wrench.§水管工人伸手从他的**成套**工具中拿出一个扳手。§
22368§generate§ˈdʒenəreɪt§Compared with ordinary coal, new "clean coals" may generate power more efficiently.§和普通煤相比，新型的“高纯度”煤可以提高**发**电效率。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
22369§remote§rɪˈməʊt§His ultimate goal was to discover an earth-like planet in remote galaxies.§他的最终目标是在**遥远**的星系中找到一颗类地行星。§
22370§avoid§əˈvɒɪd§Building big commercial buildings underground can be a way to avoid disfiguring or threatening a beautiful landscape.§在地下建商业大楼可以**避免**破坏或威胁到美丽的风景。§
22371§dismiss§dɪsˈmɪs§As sales declined, the manager had to dismiss several workers.§由于销售额下跌，经理不得不**解雇**一些员工。§
22372§absenteeism§ˌæbsənˈtiːɪzəm§In an attempt to reduce the level of absenteeism amongst employees, the company introduced three different strategies.§该公司采用了三种不同的策略，希望以此降低员工的**旷工**率。§
22373§apparent§əˈpærənt§This tendency was apparent in the late 1980s.§这种趋势在20世纪80年代末很**明显**。§
22374§succumb§səˈkʌm§Since white phosphorus is a deadly poison, match-makers exposed to its fumes often succumbed to necrosis.§因为白磷是一种剧毒物质，暴露在其粉尘中的火柴制作工人常常**死于**坏疽。§
22375§stretch§stretʃ§His feet are stretched out to an electric heater.§他的脚**伸**到了电暖气上。§
